note: Archetypes are judgement written down in advance: three roles each invented profile could plausibly land. Requirements are illustrative only. Outreach targets are roles and organisation types, never people.

archetypes.label: Ward nurse, acute or geriatric care
archetypes.reason: Twelve years on general wards maps onto the German reference occupation once recognition is through.

requirements.german_why: Ward handovers and documentation are in German, and most Länder ask for B2 in the recognition procedure for nursing.

recognition.item: Recognition as Pflegefachfrau / Pflegefachmann has not been applied for
recognition.why: Nursing is regulated: the professional title cannot be used on a ward without recognition by the competent body of the Land.
recognition.typical_duration: typically 3-4 months for the authority's assessment once the file is complete, longer where documents must be sourced
recognition.next_step: Book free counselling and file the Antrag auf Anerkennung with the competent body of the Land (anerkennung-in-deutschland.de).

credentials.item: telc Deutsch B2-C1 Beruf Pflege certificate
credentials.why: Several Länder and many hospital employers ask for a nursing-specific language certificate rather than a general B2.
credentials.typical_duration: typically 4-8 months of course time, depending on the level you start from
credentials.next_step: Ask the competent body which certificate it accepts before booking a course.

credentials.item: Anpassungslehrgang or preparation for the Kenntnisprufung, whichever the authority sets
credentials.why: Where the authority finds substantial differences, one of these two is the route named in its decision. Which one applies is not decided here.
credentials.typical_duration: typically 6-12 months for an Anpassungslehrgang; typically 3-6 months of preparation for a Kenntnisprufung
credentials.next_step: Wait for the authority's written decision, which names the route that applies to your case.

outreach.target: Professional association for nursing (Berufsverband)
outreach.organisation: A nursing professional association active in the Land
outreach.why: Associations run peer groups for internationally qualified nurses and publish what the Land asks for.

outreach.target: Pflegekammer of the Land, where the Land has one
outreach.organisation: Land nursing chamber (not every Land has established one)
outreach.why: Where a nursing chamber exists it registers the profession and can say what registration needs.

outreach.target: Mentoring programme for internationally qualified health staff
outreach.organisation: A migrant-professional network for the health sector
outreach.why: Peer networks are where the practical sequence of the recognition steps gets explained by people who did it.

archetypes.label: Assistant post held during the recognition procedure
archetypes.reason: Assistant and Anerkennungspraktikum posts are the usual way to work on a ward while the file is with the authority.

requirements.german_why: Assistant posts still involve patient contact and shift handovers, and most ads in this group name B1.

recognition.item: The recognition application has not been filed, and this route depends on it being under way
recognition.why: An Anerkennungspraktikum is part of the procedure: employers in this group ask to see that the Antrag has been submitted.
recognition.typical_duration: typically a few weeks to prepare and file, once translated documents are in hand
recognition.next_step: File the Antrag first, then apply to posts in this group with the receipt.

credentials.item: Basiskurs Pflege or an equivalent care-assistant qualification from a recognised provider
credentials.why: Assistant posts outside the recognition procedure usually ask for a short German care qualification.
credentials.next_step: Ask the employer whether the Anerkennungspraktikum route makes this course unnecessary in your case.

credentials.why: Routinely asked for at the start of a care post.

outreach.target: Recognition counselling service (IQ Netzwerk counselling centre)
outreach.organisation: Free official counselling on recognition procedures
outreach.why: Counselling is free and can tell you which employers in the Land take people mid-procedure.

outreach.target: Industrie- und Handelskammer of the city
outreach.organisation: Chamber of commerce and industry, present in every German city
outreach.why: Chambers hold the employer lists and run information evenings for newcomers to the labour market.

outreach.target: Peer group for nurses in the recognition procedure
outreach.organisation: A migrant-professional network for the health sector
outreach.why: The order of the steps is the thing people get wrong, and peers have just done it.

archetypes.label: Care coordination, quality and case management
archetypes.reason: Twelve years and six roles carry the process knowledge these posts ask for, and they are not regulated.

requirements.german_why: These posts are mostly written German: documentation, audits and correspondence with payers.

credentials.item: Short course in Qualitatsmanagement im Gesundheitswesen
credentials.why: Quality and coordination ads in this group name a QM qualification more often than they name recognition.
credentials.next_step: Compare providers through the Land's further-training database.

credentials.item: General B2 certificate, for example Goethe-Zertifikat B2 or telc Deutsch B2
credentials.why: Non-regulated posts accept a general certificate, so the nursing-specific one is not needed for this route.
credentials.typical_duration: typically 3-6 months of course time from B1
credentials.next_step: Book the exam once a placement test puts you at B2.

credentials.item: ZAB Statement of Comparability for the foreign degree
credentials.why: Not recognition, and generally not required to work. Some employers and visa procedures ask for it as a document about the qualification.
credentials.typical_duration: typically 3 months for the Zentralstelle to issue it
credentials.next_step: Ask the employer whether they need it at all before applying for one.

outreach.target: Professional association for health-service management
outreach.organisation: A management association in the health sector
outreach.why: Coordination posts are filled through sector networks more often than through portals.

outreach.target: Industrie- und Handelskammer of the city
outreach.organisation: Chamber of commerce and industry, present in every German city
outreach.why: The chamber certifies several of the QM courses this route asks for.

outreach.target: Network for internationally qualified professionals in the health sector
outreach.organisation: A migrant-professional network for the health sector
outreach.why: Useful for finding employers that already hire outside the regulated route.

archetypes.label: Design engineer, CAD and product development
archetypes.reason: Eight years of machine building maps most directly onto Konstruktion posts.

requirements.german_why: Drawings, standards and supplier correspondence in this group are in German.

recognition.item: Permission to use the protected title Ingenieur has not been applied for
recognition.why: Where the post carries the title Ingenieur, the Ingenieurkammer of the Land must permit it. Work under another job title often does not need it.
recognition.typical_duration: typically 2-4 months for the chamber to decide
recognition.next_step: Ask the Ingenieurkammer of the Land whether the posts you want require the title, then apply if they do.

credentials.item: Vendor certification for the CAD system the employer uses
credentials.why: Ads in this group name a specific CAD system, and a vendor certificate is the shortest way to evidence it.
credentials.next_step: Read the ads first and certify on the system they actually name.

credentials.item: Refresher on German and ISO drawing standards, for example geometrical product specification
credentials.why: Tolerancing conventions differ, and this group's work is checked against those standards.
credentials.next_step: Chambers and technical academies run these as short seminars.

outreach.target: Engineering professional association
outreach.organisation: A national engineering association with Land branches
outreach.why: Branch evenings are where design departments say what they are hiring for.

outreach.target: Ingenieurkammer of the Land
outreach.organisation: Land chamber of engineers
outreach.why: It decides on the protected title and can say whether a post needs it.

outreach.target: Network for internationally qualified engineers
outreach.organisation: A migrant-professional network for engineering
outreach.why: Title questions come up constantly there and the answers are Land-specific.

archetypes.label: Manufacturing and process planning
archetypes.reason: Series production experience fits Arbeitsvorbereitung and process posts, which do not need the protected title.

requirements.german_why: Shop-floor coordination and work instructions are in German.

credentials.why: Process improvement posts in this group name it often enough that its absence is noticed.
credentials.next_step: Check whether the employer runs its own in-house programme first.

credentials.item: REFA Grundschein in work organisation, or a comparable Arbeitsvorbereitung qualification
credentials.why: German manufacturing planning has its own method vocabulary, and this is the usual evidence of it.
credentials.next_step: Ask the employer which of the two they recognise.

credentials.item: ZAB Statement of Comparability for the foreign degree
credentials.why: Not recognition, and generally not required to work. Useful only where an employer or a visa procedure asks for a document about the degree.
credentials.typical_duration: typically 3 months for the Zentralstelle to issue it
credentials.next_step: Ask whether it is needed before applying for one.

outreach.target: Association for work organisation and industrial engineering
outreach.organisation: A methods and work-organisation association
outreach.why: It runs the qualification this route asks for and knows which plants accept it.

outreach.target: Industrie- und Handelskammer of the city
outreach.organisation: Chamber of commerce and industry, present in every German city
outreach.why: Chambers keep the local manufacturer lists and certify further training.

outreach.target: Network for internationally qualified engineers
outreach.organisation: A migrant-professional network for engineering
outreach.why: Good for finding plants that hire without the protected title.

archetypes.label: Technical service and commissioning
archetypes.reason: Field service and commissioning accept a lower German level and value the breadth of eight years.

requirements.german_why: Customer visits need spoken German, but reports in this group are often short and templated.

credentials.item: German driving licence, or conversion (Umschreibung) of a non-EU licence
credentials.why: Field service ads in this group ask for Fuhrerschein Klasse B as a condition of the post.
credentials.typical_duration: typically 2-6 months, depending on whether a test is required
credentials.next_step: Check the conversion rules with the Fuhrerscheinstelle of the city.

credentials.item: Elektrofachkraft fur festgelegte Tatigkeiten, where the post includes electrical work
credentials.why: Commissioning posts that touch electrical systems require a German qualification for those tasks.
credentials.next_step: Ask the employer whether the post's tasks fall under it.

outreach.target: Engineering professional association, service and maintenance branch
outreach.organisation: A national engineering association with Land branches
outreach.why: Service departments recruit through the branch groups.

outreach.target: Industrie- und Handelskammer of the city
outreach.organisation: Chamber of commerce and industry, present in every German city
outreach.why: It certifies the short electrical qualification this route may need.

outreach.target: Network for internationally qualified technical staff
outreach.organisation: A migrant-professional network for engineering
outreach.why: Licence conversion is a recurring topic there.

archetypes.label: Backend developer in an English-working team
archetypes.reason: Five years of backend work fits the teams that run in English and do not ask for recognition.

requirements.german_why: The English-only posts do not need it, but the rest of this group asks for at least B1 for everything outside the codebase.

credentials.item: Associate-level developer certification for the cloud platform the employer uses
credentials.why: The ads in this group name a platform, and an associate certificate is the cheapest signal for a candidate without a German work history.
credentials.next_step: Pick the platform from the shortlist rather than in advance.

credentials.item: ZAB Statement of Comparability for the degree
credentials.why: Not recognition, and not required to work in this non-regulated field. It appears here only because visa procedures sometimes ask for it.
credentials.typical_duration: typically 3 months for the Zentralstelle to issue it
credentials.next_step: Ask whether the specific procedure needs it before applying.

outreach.target: Professional association for computing
outreach.organisation: A national computing society with local chapters
outreach.why: Chapters run the meetups where English-working teams recruit.

outreach.target: Industrie- und Handelskammer of the city
outreach.organisation: Chamber of commerce and industry, present in every German city
outreach.why: It keeps the local employer register and runs newcomer information evenings.

outreach.target: Network for internationally qualified tech professionals
outreach.organisation: A migrant-professional network for the tech sector
outreach.why: Referrals here reach the teams that already hire without German.

archetypes.label: Data engineer, pipelines and warehousing
archetypes.reason: The data half of the profile fits pipeline and warehouse posts, which are the most English-tolerant group here.

requirements.german_why: Stakeholders outside the data team are usually German-speaking, even where the team is not.

credentials.item: Associate-level data engineering certification for the employer's cloud platform
credentials.why: Pipeline posts in this group screen on platform experience first.
credentials.next_step: Match the platform to the shortlisted employers before booking.

credentials.item: Dimensional modelling and advanced SQL course
credentials.why: Warehouse posts ask for modelling, not only pipelines.
credentials.next_step: Any structured course is enough; the portfolio matters more.

outreach.target: Professional association for computing, data chapter
outreach.organisation: A national computing society with local chapters
outreach.why: Data chapters are small and the hiring leads speak at them.

outreach.target: Industrie- und Handelskammer of the city
outreach.organisation: Chamber of commerce and industry, present in every German city
outreach.why: Industrial employers hiring data staff are on the chamber's register rather than on job portals.

outreach.target: Network for internationally qualified tech professionals
outreach.organisation: A migrant-professional network for the tech sector
outreach.why: The same referral route as the backend archetype, different rooms.

archetypes.label: IT operations and platform administration
archetypes.reason: Operations posts are the widest door for a developer without German, though the German-facing ones ask for more language.

requirements.german_why: Operations touches every other department, and support conversations in this group are in German.

credentials.item: Linux administration certification, for example LPIC-1
credentials.why: Administration posts screen on a Linux certificate where there is no German work history to read.

outreach.target: Professional association for computing, systems chapter
outreach.organisation: A national computing society with local chapters
outreach.why: Operations roles are filled by word of mouth more than the developer ones.

outreach.target: Industrie- und Handelskammer of the city
outreach.organisation: Chamber of commerce and industry, present in every German city
outreach.why: Mid-sized employers with in-house IT are on the chamber register.

outreach.target: Network for internationally qualified tech professionals
outreach.organisation: A migrant-professional network for the tech sector
outreach.why: Where the German-language expectation gets discussed honestly.
